audio.help.title: Analyze audio
audio.help.intro: Analyze audio turns an already-written transcript into an organized summary of what was discussed. It lives inside Pending and proposes tasks, but you decide which ones to create.
audio.help.first.title: First steps
audio.help.first.step1: Open Pending, go to “📋 Tasks” or “🎙️ Reports”, and tap “Audio” or “Analyze audio”.
audio.help.first.step2: Paste the transcript, already converted to text, into the large field.
audio.help.first.step3: Tap “Analyze” and confirm the AI run, which uses tokens.
audio.help.first.step4: Browse the tree of summary, segments, plan, speakers, proposed tasks and Raw.
audio.help.first.step5: Create only the tasks you want, create them all, or move them together into a plan.

audio.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
audio.help.buttons.transcript.v: Receives text; this module doesn't convert a voice recording to text.
audio.help.buttons.analyze.v: Interprets the text with AI. It uses tokens and asks for confirmation before starting.
audio.help.buttons.history.v: Opens a previous report without using tokens again.
audio.help.buttons.editTitle.v: Changes the title generated by AI; Enter or leaving the field saves, and Esc cancels.
audio.help.buttons.createOne.v: Creates only that proposal in Pending.
audio.help.buttons.createAll.v: Creates all proposals that aren't already marked as created.
audio.help.buttons.toPlan.v: Creates a plan with the report's title and summary and assigns all proposed tasks to it.
audio.help.buttons.tree.v: Expands or collapses each branch of the interpretation.
audio.help.buttons.raw.v: Shows the original text and the complete technical result.
audio.help.warning.title: Watch out
audio.help.warning.text: “Analyze” uses real tokens. Interpretation is read-only and no task is created automatically: every proposal requires tapping “Create task”, “Create all” or “Move to plan”.
